findings.highlight: Please let me talk to you
findings.governingReading: hear me out and advise me
findings.explanation: Shirou asks Rin to take on his problem and counsel him, not merely permit him to speak.

findings.evidenceJa: ここで決着つけるってのはあくまで喩え
findings.governingReading: settling things here was only a figure of speech
findings.explanation: Rin’s explanation of the comic misunderstanding is replaced by a vague denial.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとかしたいんだけど
findings.governingReading: I want to do something about it
findings.explanation: Shirou’s desire to act and protect Sakura is reduced to disliking the situation.

findings.evidenceJa: 遅れて、いまさら頬がカアっと熱くなった
findings.governingReading: only belatedly, now of all times, my cheeks flare hot
findings.explanation: The delayed onset that makes Shirou recognize his embarrassment after releasing Rin is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 頬がカアっと熱くなった
findings.explanation: The localized blush in Shirou’s cheeks becomes a generic burning face.

findings.highlight: You want to ask me something
findings.evidenceJa: 相談事があるんでしょ
findings.governingReading: you have something you want to consult me about
findings.explanation: Rin’s recognition that Shirou needs counsel becomes an unspecified question.

findings.highlight: Come up to the rooftop during lunchtime
findings.explanation: Rin’s mild rebuke of Shirou’s incredulous response is omitted.
Rin’s pointedly evasive gesture is flattened into an ordinary turn.

findings.evidenceJa: どこか拗ねたような口調で
findings.governingReading: in a tone that sounded somehow sulky
findings.explanation: The narration’s characterization of Rin’s lingering line as faintly sulky disappears entirely.
